sleepkeeper.name: Sleepkeeper
sleepkeeper.desc: {Sleepkeeper} While equipped, the artifact provides the hero's creatures with immunity to Mind spells.

runesofimminency.name: Runes of Imminency
runesofimminency.desc: {Runes of Imminency} Decrease enemy's Luck by 1.

royalarmorofnix.name: Royal Armor of Nix
royalarmorofnix.desc: {Royal Armor of Nix} Worn on the torso, this item increases your Power skill by +6.

wayfarerboots.name: Wayfarer's Boots
wayfarerboots.desc: {Wayfarer's Boots} Worn on the feet, these boots allow your hero to move over rough terrain without penalty.

hornoftheabyss.name: Horn of the Abyss
hornoftheabyss.desc: {Horn of the Abyss} Using the spell of Horn of the Abyss, you can rise Fangarms from any corpses from both side, except non-living creatures.

crownofthefiveseas.name: Crown of the Five Seas
crownofthefiveseas.desc: {Crown of the Five Seas} Worn on the head, this item increases your Knowledge skill by 6.

ringofsuppression.name: Ring of Suppression
ringofsuppression.desc: {Ring of Suppression} Worn on the finger, this ring decreases enemy's Morale by 1.

plateofdyinglight.name: Plate of Dying Light
plateofdyinglight.desc: {Plate of Dying Light} Worn on a torso, this item reduces the Power skill of enemy hero by 25% during combat.

ringofoblivion.name: Ring of Oblivion
ringofoblivion.desc: {Ring of Oblivion} When worn, makes all losses in the battle irrevocable.

goldengoose.name: Golden Goose
goldengoose.desc: {Golden Goose} When equipped, the Golden Goose increases your income by a total of 7000 gold per day.

tridentofdominion.name: Trident of Dominion
tridentofdominion.desc: {Trident of Dominion} This right-handed weapon increases your Attack skill by 7.

shieldofnavalglory.name: Shield of Naval Glory
shieldofnavalglory.desc: {Shield of Naval Glory} This left-handed item increases your Defense skill by 7.

pendantofreflection.name: Pendant of Reflection
pendantofreflection.desc: {Pendant of Reflection} Increases your Magic Resistance additionally by 20%.

capeofsilence.name: Cape of Silence
capeofsilence.desc: {Cape of Silence} While wearing this cape, neither you nor your opponent will be able to cast level 1-2 spells during combat.

pendantofdownfall.name: Pendant of Downfall
pendantofdownfall.desc: {Pendant of Downfall} Worn about the neck, this item decreases enemy's Morale by 2.

sealofsunset.name: Seal of Sunset
sealofsunset.desc: {Seal of Sunset} Worn on a finger, this item reduces the Power skill of enemy hero by 10% during combat.

charmofeclipse.name: Charm of Eclipse
charmofeclipse.desc: {Charm Of Eclipse} This item reduces the Power skill of enemy hero by 10% during combat.

diplomatscloak.name: Diplomat's Cloak
diplomatscloak.desc: {Diplomat's Cloak} Allows your hero to retreat or surrender when battling neutral monsters or defending a town. Multiplies your hero army strength by 3 (for neutral armies and Thieves guild). **NOT IMPLEMENTED in VCMI yet**

ironfistoftheogre.name: Ironfist Of The Ogre
ironfistoftheogre.desc: {Ironfist Of The Ogre} At the beginning of every combat casts Haste, Bloodlust, Fire Shield and Counterstrike spells on expert level on all of your creatures for fifty rounds.
